ui.gauntlet.title: The Forgotten Four
ui.gauntlet.order_help: All four Awakened, one after another. Drag the cards into the order you'll fight them (or use their arrows, or the arrow keys). Each is harder than the last.
ui.gauntlet.rules: Each fight as its adventurer, no pets, items or relics. A fifth of the hitpoints you lose carries to the next. Between fights, a camp: spend the points a fight earns on a blessing. Fall, and retry that fight or start over; only a run with no retries is clean.

ui.gauntlet.hard_locked: A clean clear opens hard mode

ui.gauntlet.blessings: Blessings: one for the next fight
ui.gauntlet.badge: The Forgotten Four: fight {n} of {total}, boss {climb}
ui.gauntlet.fallen_help: Retry this fight from its start, with the wounds, points and blessing you came in with, or start over from the first.
ui.gauntlet.cleared_hard: The Forgotten Four have fallen, on hard!
ui.gauntlet.new_record: A new best for this order
ui.gauntlet.reward_looks: Blood-touched: the Soulreaper axe and the four fighting pets
ui.gauntlet.clean_for_reward: A clean run (no retries) earns the blood-touched looks, the gold card and hard mode.

ui.hard.tooltip.open: More enemies, tougher and harder hitting, twice the elites, and bosses that enrage sooner and attack faster. Coins are worth 25% more.
